receiver.target: Godot 4.7.2 GL Compatibility direct glTF skin import
receiver.target_mode: actual imported skinned GLB shaded by target-host deformed direction frames
receiver.reference_mode: exact owner positions with area-weighted indexed smooth normals recomputed after pose, rendered with the exact receiver-local host-equivalent triangle relation
receiver.stale_control_mode: exact owner positions with neutral 0-degree smooth normals reused after pose, rendered with the same host-equivalent triangle relation
receiver.native_history_control: pose-recomputed owner reference rendered with historical native owner triangle order
receiver.negative_control: host-equivalent pose-recomputed reference with inverted normals
receiver.position_control: unshaded target import versus host-equivalent exact owner-position reference
receiver.host_equivalent_relation: per triangle [a,b,c] -> [a,c,b] for this exact pinned Godot receiver only

classification.neutral_host_equivalent_gate: at exact 0 degrees the imported target must remain spatially aligned and shade within the Technical-Art receiver-local adapted-reference evidence bound before deformed comparisons are interpreted
classification.pose_following_preferred_when: all six deformed view comparisons are closer to the host-equivalent pose-recomputed reference than to the host-equivalent frozen-neutral control after the neutral and position gates close
classification.frozen_like_when: all six deformed view comparisons are closer to the host-equivalent frozen-neutral control
classification.mixed_when: deformed contexts disagree after the neutral and position gates close
